control.title: Centralised logging with retention in India
control.description: Collect security and access logs from all ICT systems centrally, protect them from tampering, and retain them for at least one year within India (meets CERT-In 180 days and DPDP one year).

evidence_hint: Logging architecture, retention settings and storage region.
acceptance_criteria: Logs from key systems are collected centrally
Retention is at least 180 days and stored in India where required

criteria_coverage.criterion: Logs from key systems are collected centrally

requirements.title: Maintain ICT system logs for 180 days in India
requirements.guidance: Enable logs of all ICT systems and keep them securely for a rolling period of 180 days within Indian jurisdiction. Provide them to CERT-In with incident reports or when ordered.

requirements.title: Reasonable security safeguards
requirements.guidance: Protect personal data in your possession or control, including processing by processors, with reasonable security safeguards to prevent a personal data breach.

requirements.title: Security event collection and analysis
requirements.guidance: Collect and analyse security events to raise alerts proactively.

requirements.title: MFA for debits, real-time fraud monitoring, 24x7 desk, 5-year logs
requirements.guidance: MFA for electronic debits unless relaxed, real-time fraud monitoring, a manned 24x7x365 desk for fraud complaints and law enforcement, audit logs kept at least five years, anti-phishing and rogue-app takedown.

requirements.title: Anomaly monitoring
requirements.guidance: Monitor system components for anomalies that indicate malicious acts or errors.

requirements.title: Visibility of access through logs and monitoring
requirements.guidance: Keep visibility on access to personal data through logs, monitoring and review, so unauthorised access can be detected, investigated and remediated.

requirements.title: Retain logs for at least one year
requirements.guidance: Retain logs and relevant personal data for at least one year for detecting and investigating unauthorised access, unless another law requires otherwise.

requirements.title: Logging
requirements.guidance: Produce, store, protect and analyse logs of activities and events.
